prompt:
Task / size class:
Loop 080 — bounded MEDIUM docs/tests-only Antigravity account-route read-only checklist.

Goal:
Prepare one machine-checkable STATIC/read-only inspection contract for the Google/Antigravity `antigravity_account_route` gap. Define exactly what a future separately authorized read-only inspection must observe to establish that the authenticated identity is the intended Google AI Pro / Antigravity account route, without sending any provider/model turn, revealing private account identifiers or credentials, changing authentication/settings/billing/permissions, or claiming the route is already proven.

Read first:
- docs/JULES_TASK_PROMPT_SPEC.md
- docs/RELAY_LIVE_EVIDENCE_ACQUISITION_PLAN.md
- docs/RELAY_LIVE_BLOCKERS.md
- docs/RELAY_SUBSCRIPTION_ROUTE_READONLY_CHECKLIST.md
- docs/RELAY_MINIMUM_PERMISSIONS_STATIC_INVENTORY.md
- src/providers/policy.py
- src/providers/preflight.py
- src/providers/antigravity_acp.py
- existing related Relay tests before writing new assertions

Allowed changed paths — EXACTLY these three and no others:
- docs/RELAY_ANTIGRAVITY_ACCOUNT_ROUTE_READONLY_CHECKLIST.md
- tests/relay/test_antigravity_account_route_readonly_checklist.py
- docs/RELAY_STATIC_CHECKPOINT.md

Hard path-fence rule:
- The final diff MUST contain only the three paths above.
- Do NOT create, modify, rename, stage, submit, or include plan.md.
- Do NOT create any planning, scratch, notes, metadata, lock, cache, generated, or helper file.
- Before submit, inspect the final changed-file list and require exact equality with the three allowed paths.
- If any extra path cannot be removed safely, STOP instead of submitting.

Hard scope / Do Not Touch:
- docs/tests/checkpoint only
- no src/ production code changes
- no workflow/schema/dependency/lockfile changes
- no provider/model/API/network call
- no real Antigravity process/session/model turn
- no login/logout/auth mutation
- no settings/permissions mutation
- no API key creation/use
- no Cloud Billing or overage enablement/change
- no credential/token/cookie/private-profile inspection or storage
- no raw account email, account ID, payment, or billing data in evidence
- no Merge
- no rebase, force push, branch deletion, merge commit, or conflict auto-resolution
- retry=0
- fallback=disabled
- do not mark antigravity_account_route, antigravity_billing_route, or common_subscription_route PASS/VERIFIED/RESOLVED/READY

Existing implementation to reuse:
- Treat the live evidence plan, live blockers, subscription-route checklist, minimum-permissions inventory, provider policy, preflight, and Antigravity profile as authoritative.
- Reuse the checked-in facts that Google/Antigravity requires auth_kind=account and preflight requires alternate API-key/gateway/external-cloud/ADC/Vertex routes to be false.
- Do not reinterpret static source/config/preflight success as proof of the real authenticated identity or actual account route.
- Do not conflate this account-route gap with the separate antigravity_billing_route gap. Billing ownership/payment proof remains separately unresolved.

Required semantics:
1. Add docs/RELAY_ANTIGRAVITY_ACCOUNT_ROUTE_READONLY_CHECKLIST.md as PREPARED/static read-only inspection plan only.
2. Scope exactly provider_id=google and gap_id=antigravity_account_route.
3. Define exactly one machine-checkable current-state row containing at least:
   provider_id, gap_id,
   static_expected_auth_kind_state,
   static_alternate_route_guard_state,
   observed_authenticated_identity_state,
   observed_credential_kind_state,
   observed_product_route_state,
   api_key_route_absence_state,
   adc_route_absence_state,
   vertex_route_absence_state,
   readonly_inspection_state,
   evidence_provenance_state,
   blocker_state.
4. Allowed current-state vocabulary only:
   STATIC_PREPARED, EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, UNKNOWN, BLOCKED_UNKNOWN.
5. Checked-in auth-kind and alternate-route guard fields may be STATIC_PREPARED. Actual identity/credential/product-route and route-absence observations remain EVIDENCE_REQUIRED or UNKNOWN. blocker_state remains BLOCKED_UNKNOWN.
6. Explicitly distinguish:
   - ProviderPolicy required_auth_kind=account;
   - preflight static rejection of API-key/gateway/external-cloud/ADC/Vertex alternate routes;
   - static Antigravity binary/profile selection;
   - actual observed authenticated identity class;
   - actual observed credential mechanism/kind;
   - actual observed Google AI Pro / Antigravity product/account route;
   - proof that API-key/ADC/Vertex routes are not selected;
   - inspection event identity and evidence provenance.
7. State that checked-in config/defaults, successful preflight, binary/profile selection, successful login label, or repository absence of API-key material are individually insufficient to prove the actual authenticated account route.
8. Define future conceptual read-only evidence fields:
   provider_id, gap_id, inspection_correlation_id,
   intended_account_route,
   observed_auth_kind,
   observed_identity_class,
   observed_credential_kind,
   observed_product_route,
   api_key_route_state,
   adc_route_state,
   vertex_route_state,
   evidence_source,
   evidence_locator_or_hash,
   captured_at,
   verification_state.
9. Evidence stores classifications/durable locators or hashes only. No raw secrets, API keys, OAuth tokens, cookies, passwords, account emails, account IDs, full private profile dumps, payment identifiers, or billing data.
10. Evidence must be Google/Antigravity inspection-event bound. Evidence from OpenAI, Anthropic, another Google account, another product route, or another inspection cannot satisfy this gap.
11. Fail closed / remain BLOCKED_UNKNOWN when any of these are unknown, ambiguous, conflicting, or unverifiable:
   observed auth kind,
   authenticated identity class,
   credential kind,
   product/account route,
   API-key route absence,
   ADC route absence,
   Vertex route absence,
   provider/inspection binding,
   evidence provenance.
12. Any observed API-key, ADC, Vertex, gateway, external-cloud, or mismatched product/account route is a hard proof failure for this gap and must not be normalized to the intended account route.
13. If proof would require sending a model/provider turn, reading a raw secret/private account identifier, changing login/auth/settings/permissions/billing, enabling an API key/Cloud Billing/overage route, or widening access, that proof method is outside this batch and forbidden.
14. State that zero external/read-only account-route evidence is acquired by this batch.
15. State that antigravity_account_route remains unresolved/BLOCKED_UNKNOWN.
16. Explicitly state that antigravity_billing_route is separate and remains unresolved/BLOCKED_UNKNOWN; this checklist must not claim billing ownership/payment route is proven.
17. Update docs/RELAY_STATIC_CHECKPOINT.md with PREPARED/static Antigravity account-route checklist status only; no live blocker becomes resolved.

Negative / tamper / failure cases:
- exact provider_id google and gap_id antigravity_account_route
- exactly one current-state row
- allowed state vocabulary is not widened
- static auth/preflight/profile cannot satisfy observed identity/credential/product-route fields
- UNKNOWN/ambiguous identity fails closed
- UNKNOWN credential kind fails closed
- API-key/ADC/Vertex route absence UNKNOWN fails closed
- any selected alternate route fails proof
- mismatched Google account/product route fails proof
- cross-provider/cross-account/cross-inspection evidence cannot satisfy this gap
- raw secret/private account identifiers are forbidden
- all conceptual evidence field names are present
- zero external/read-only account-route evidence acquired
- antigravity_account_route remains unresolved/BLOCKED_UNKNOWN
- antigravity_billing_route remains separate unresolved/BLOCKED_UNKNOWN
- checkpoint preserves same boundary
- no vacuous tests

Acceptance criteria:
- exact allowed-path fence
- production/workflow/schema code unchanged
- direct assertions cover required semantics and negative cases
- no provider/model/API/network/auth/settings/permission/billing action
- no positive authenticated-route or billing-route claim
- retry=0 and fallback disabled remain explicit
- full Relay validation green

Exact validation commands:
PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v
python -m compileall -q src tests
git diff --check

- Require exact set equality with:
  docs/RELAY_ANTIGRAVITY_ACCOUNT_ROUTE_READONLY_CHECKLIST.md
  docs/RELAY_STATIC_CHECKPOINT.md
  tests/relay/test_antigravity_account_route_readonly_checklist.py

Create the normal isolated Jules PR only if the exact path fence holds and all required validation is green. Do not Merge.

- any extra path cannot be removed from final diff

- auth/settings/permissions/billing must be changed
- raw credentials/secrets/private account identifiers must be inspected
